text: The Patriots authored one of Week 4's most dramatic reversals, clawing back from what looked like a season-defining 1-3 start to upset the Bills 29-26 at the new Highmark Stadium—a victory that proved particularly redemptive for Drake Maye, who shook off an early-season slide and a pair of turnovers to orchestrate a game-winning drive while throwing three touchdown passes in the process. Head Coach Mike Vrabel, who underscored the critical importance of the win for the defending AFC champions, highlighted how New England's defense outlasted Josh Allen and the Bills' quick-strike offense in a close battle that made the Patriots the first team to win in Buffalo's newly opened venue. The comeback has sparked considerable debate among analysts about whether these Patriots are genuinely back on track for another AFC East title or whether Week 4 overreactions are getting ahead of the team's progress, though the film breakdown of Maye's performance and the offense's explosive second half suggests something genuinely clicked at the right moment for a squad that badly needed a momentum shift.
